source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Two things about power board which I think is final:
1\. Physical power button connector — a 2-pin JST-GH connector (J\_PWR\_BTN) for a panel-mounted momentary button wired to the AXP2101 PWRON pin. Press to turn on, press to turn off.
2\. DCDC1 output voltage — set AXP2101 DCDC1 to 3.4V (not 3.3V) via I2C to compensate for the Schottky diode drop on the main board power OR-ing circuit, keeping the 3.3V rail at the correct voltage under all conditions.

value_updates.control_behavior: press to turn on and press to turn off

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I'm not sure if it will have enough space for another connector

ambiguity.description: The proposed power-board location may not have sufficient space for the panel power-button connector.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: No problem on the power board. Can you add a 2-pin JST-GH connector on the main board for a panel-mounted power button? PWRON already comes in on J\_PWR\_SIG pin 4, just need a connector that taps into that line so we can wire a button from the enclosure panel.
